Keep this handy

Everything is inside this page — all six tickets, every map link, the full plan. In Safari, tap Share → Add to Home Screen to keep it one tap away.

Want it as a PDF too? — the whole plan and all six tickets in one file you can email, print, or keep in Books.

Tap a place name to open it in maps. Tap a code to copy it. Show ticket opens the real ticket, stored inside this page — it works with no signal at all. Walk times are estimates at a normal pace on city streets — add a few minutes in crowds.

You can't hail a taxi in the street in Italy. Use a rank or an app (FreeNow, appTaxi, IT Taxi). Nearest ranks: Largo Argentina or Piazza Venezia in Rome, Piazza della Stazione or Piazza San Marco in Florence.
